newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Jospin spokesman disowns minister's EMU comments.
newsitem.headline: Jospin spokesman disowns minister's EMU comments.

text.p: A spokesman for French Prime Minister Lionel Jospin on Tuesday disowned comments made by French European Affairs Minister Pierre Moscovici on the European Union's planned monetary union (EMU), saying he had spoken "too quickly".

Moscovici told Radio Luxembourg earlier on Tuesday that Paris would make a final decision whether to join the common European currency once it assessed the state of its public finances. He said the next six months would be crucial for the future of the single currency.
Asked to comment on Moscovici's comments, Jospin's spokesman Manuel Valls said: "He spoke too quickly. This is not our political will."

Valls said the position spelled out several times by Jospin was that France would meet the criteria and deadline set for EMU. "This will not be done to the detriment of employment and growth," he added.
